text:
Lina: Quick flag  billing batch 2026-04-EU had several invoices with either missing VAT or duplicated invoice records. Noticing patterns around currency lookups.

Diego: Which invoices? Any sample IDs?

Lina: Sample from logs: inv_EU_2026_9987 appears twice. One copy: `total_eur: 950, vat: null` and another: `total_eur: 1150, vat:200`. Support reported a customer saw both PDFs.

Priya: Oof. Did our retry logic kick in? billing-job v3.5 has a retry wrapper when exchange service times out.

billing-bot: Alert: 4 duplicate invoice objects created during 2026-04-05T11:02:00Z - suspected exchange-rate fallback + retry.

Diego: Root hypothesis: idempotency key includes `rate_source` flag which changes when fallback used, so retry creates a distinct invoice instead of deduping.

Lina: Also saw one case where a compute line doubled (x2) while VAT was omitted in the fallback run. That made accounts totals inconsistent.

Priya: Repro: run generator with mocked exchange API returning 502 on first call, then OK. When fallback to cached rate occurs, job writes invoice A. Retry then gets OK rate, writes invoice B. Both persisted.

Diego: Immediate mitigation: flip exchange failures to halt invoice finalization and place invoice into manual review queue until a human confirms. I'll open a short-lived feature flag.

Eve: For customers who received two PDFs, we should mark the incorrect one as void and send corrected invoice with apology + explanation. I'll coordinate with CS.

Lina: Support list: Zenith EU (received dupe), Tonic Labs, and Acme EU. Priya please add those to reconciliation-run.

Priya: Added. Also pushing a fix: change idempotency key to use `org_id + period + usage_hash` only. PR: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/412 (tests added).

Diego: Good. Add an end-to-end test that simulates exchange API transient failures and asserts only one invoice is created and VAT computed deterministically.

billing-bot: Note: scheduled job paused for 1 hour while we deploy the hotfix.

Eve: Drafting customer messages now. Lina, share list of any invoices that already hit payment gateway so finance can reconcile refunds or voids.

Lina: Two had charges captured. Marked in the sheet. Finance cc'ed.

Priya: Hotfix merged to staging, running smoke tests, aiming for prod deploy in 30m. Will also add metric for fallback rate >0.5% to page on-call.

Diego: Thanks team. After deploy we'll run a de-dupe job to soft-void duplicates and reissue correct invoices, keeping audit trail.
